summary: NorthStrive Acquisition Corp I filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $100 million gross proceeds, plus a simultaneous private placement of 231,750 units to the sponsor for $2.3175 million. Each unit includes one Class A ordinary share, one right to one-quarter share upon business combination, and one warrant exercisable at $11.50. Underwriters have a 45-day over-allotment option for 1.5 million additional units. This is a routine SPAC IPO closing disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic events are present; watch for subsequent business combination announcements.
